strings.name: William Ding
strings.summary: William Ding founded NetEase and led its development from internet services into online games, music and other digital businesses. He is the group’s director and CEO. Products are developed by company and partner teams; the group and listed entities such as NetEase Cloud Music are distinct.
strings.coverageNote: Reviewed through November 17, 2026. Business founding and incorporation, interim and permanent CEO tenures, and group and subsidiary listings are distinguished. Birth retained to year only.
strings.influence.rationale: Founded NetEase, developing internet services, online games and digital content with a lasting influence on China’s internet industry.
strings.facts.f1.label: Education
strings.facts.f1.value: Bachelor’s degree in Communication Technology from UESTC; the corporate English biography calls it a Bachelor of Science.
strings.facts.f2.label: Early management roles
strings.facts.f2.value: Served as co-CTO, interim CEO and chief architect; his current CEO tenure began in November 2005.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Games and internet services
strings.highlights.h1.text: Led NetEase’s development of in-house games and licensed publishing, retaining the creative contributions of development teams and external partners.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Digital music platform
strings.highlights.h2.text: The group launched NetEase Cloud Music in 2013 and later listed the subsidiary; works on the platform are not Ding’s personal creations.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Comments on second-quarter and interim results
strings.timeline.t1.text: As CEO and director, discusses games and original-content strategy in the unaudited results announcement.
strings.timeline.t2.title: NetEase and Blizzard announce renewed agreement
strings.timeline.t2.text: Dated in China time; the announcement plans sequential mainland China service returns from that summer, not a simultaneous reopening that day.
strings.timeline.t3.title: NetEase Cloud Music lists in Hong Kong
strings.timeline.t3.text: The majority-controlled subsidiary completes its IPO; NetEase retains control and financial consolidation.
strings.timeline.t4.title: NetEase lists in Hong Kong
strings.timeline.t4.text: Ordinary shares list under 9999, distinct from the earlier Nasdaq listing of NTES depositary shares.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Group launches NetEase Cloud Music
strings.timeline.t5.text: NetEase expands into music streaming, later forming a separately listed subsidiary.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Reappointed NetEase CEO
strings.timeline.t6.text: The board’s appointment takes immediate effect; previously chief architect and, earlier, interim CEO.
strings.timeline.t7.title: NetEase lists on Nasdaq
strings.timeline.t7.text: American depositary shares trade under NTES; distinct from the 2020 Hong Kong listing.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Founds NetEase business
strings.timeline.t8.text: The business starts in June; the Cayman company later used for listing is incorporated in July 1999.
